lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let T := (ι (𝓕 := 𝓕)).toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF
  let C := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let M := LinearMap.mul ℂ 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra
  apply LinearMap.congr_fun₂ (f := (M.comp (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ C)).compr₂ T)
    (g := M.compr₂ ((LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι C)).comp T))
  apply LinearMap.ext_basis ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis
  intro φs' φs
  simp only [LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulRight_apply,
    LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.mul_apply', ofListBasis_eq_ofList,
    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, T, C, M]
  let S := List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)
  let E := fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ
  let X := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
    S)) *
    ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter E φs'))
  let Y := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter E φs)) *
    ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
    S))
  have split (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
      (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, E c := by simp [E, hφψ, hψφ, crAnTimeOrderRel_refl]) :
      ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs))) =
      X * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * Y := by
    rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ _ _ _ _ hl]
    simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, X, Y, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  calc
    _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        (X * ι C * Y) := by
      conv_lhs =>
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
        simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
        rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      have s1 := split [φ, ψ]
      have s2 := split [ψ, φ]
      simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at s1 s2
      simp only [map_smul]
      rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, s1, s2]
      simp [C, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append, mul_sub, sub_mul]
      rw [smul_sub, smul_comm]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      have hXY := split []
      simp only [List.append_nil, ofCrAnListF_nil, map_one, mul_one] at hXY
      rw [mul_assoc, ← hXY]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (not_not.mp hq).symm,
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, mul_smul_comm]

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hJ1 := hJ.differentiable (by simp)
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs j : ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA3 t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hb j := Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (i := j)
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) _ hA3 (j, i)) t x
  have hs j := Space.fun_deriv_sub (u := j) _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i)
  have hc j := Space.deriv_commute (u := j) (v := i) _ (hEs j)
  simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out), hs, hc] at hb
  have hg := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => ∂[i] f x)
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv] at hg
  rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hg
  unfold Space.div at hg
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt),
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
      hJ1 t).differentiableAt] at hg
  simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hg

  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out) _), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have hBt := fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) _ hA3 (j, i)) x
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c)
    hJ1 x i
  have hsum := Differentiable.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun j _ => hBt j
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub (hsum.const_mul _).differentiableAt
      (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hsum.differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]
  simp only [FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq]
  rw [Time.deriv_fun_sum _ _ (fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt)]
  simp only [hb, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.ε₀ 𝓕.μ₀, mul_inv_rev,
    div_eq_mul_inv, mul_sub, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero, one_mul]
